title: Specified ordered affine right normal form
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $N\geq1$ an integer with $NA=0$, and $S$ a scheme on which $N$ is invertible. Use the coordinate tower $X_0=S$, $X_{r+1}=\mathbf A^1_{X_r}$ and $p_d:X_d\to S$ of [def-amb-affine-trace-tower], and the ordinary small-etale finite Tate sheaves $A_T(r)=A_T(1)^{\otimes r}$, $A_T(0)=A_T$, of [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line], viewed in degree zero in $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. On the standard affine chart $j_r:X_{r+1}\to\mathbf P^1_{X_r}$ with projection $q_r$, put $W_{r,A}=j_r^*q_r^*(-)(1)[2]$ and $\mathcal G_{0,A}=1$, $\mathcal G_{r+1,A}=W_{r,A}\mathcal G_{r,A}$. Define $G_{0,A}=1$ and, for $d>0$, $G_{d,A}=p_d^*(-)\otimes_A^L A_{X_d}(d)[2d]$. Define the specified isomorphism $I_{d,A}:\mathcal G_{d,A}\xrightarrow{\sim}G_{d,A}$ to be the identity at $d=0$, and in positive dimension the existing ordered recursive affine right normal form: compose the successive pullbacks, move them through the previous tensor and shift, use the canonical Tate pullback of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], append the new Tate line on the right, reassociate without permuting factors, and add the even shifts. All unit, identity-pullback and zero-shift identifications are the canonical ones. Also define the degree-zero derived Tate product $A_T(d)\otimes_A^L A_T(1)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_T(d+1)$, for $d\geq0$ and $N$ invertible on $T$, by the flat-single tensor comparison followed by the canonical ordered Tate multiplication of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. These are specified composites, with no choice from the existence of an arbitrary isomorphism.
